description: tasks_probe: every task plan validation rule of TaskStore._plan through create: exact keys, goal/routine/request bounds, request references, modes, the environment binding (account, host, capabilities, observation time), ordered windows within a year, explicit limits and their ranges, the deadline window, step lists within max_steps, step fields, keys, titles, kinds and capabilities (including unhashable values), dependencies (distinct, missing, cyclic), partial prerequisites, reservations, read source contracts and unattended reauthentication (test_unattended_plan_cannot_add_execution_or_reauthentication), action references bound to an exact action revision/hash, unattended actions, the storage budget, and idempotent library create.
